CHR_025.name: The Moon and the Sky Coat
CHR_025.prompt: THE MOON, a luminous pale-ivory full moon with soft gray craters and a gentle sleepy face (closed crescent eyes, small smile); the night sky is drawn as a deep-indigo velvet coat with fine silver stitched seams and a row of large round silver buttons, one of which is the moon itself
CHR_025.anim_lock: The Moon - ivory moon with sleepy kind face; sky as indigo velvet coat with silver seams and round silver buttons
CHR_025.proportions: Moon fills about 1/5 of frame width in wide shots.
CHR_025.movement: Slow, dreamy; blinks and smiles only, never moves position.

CHR_024.name: Pip
CHR_024.prompt: PIP, a small round frog, bright leaf-green with a cream belly, huge golden eyes, orange blush cheeks, long springy legs, wearing a tiny knotted red-and-white checked scarf
CHR_024.anim_lock: Pip - small round leaf-green frog, cream belly, huge golden eyes, orange cheeks, red-and-white checked scarf
CHR_024.proportions: Round body, head merges with body; legs fold flat.
CHR_024.reference_requirements: Model sheet; hop cycle; carrying-button pose.

CHR_026.name: Heron
CHR_026.prompt: THE HERON, a tall, sleepy gray-blue heron with a long S-curved neck, a black crest feather that droops over one eye, a long yellow beak and thin yellow legs
CHR_026.anim_lock: Heron - tall gray-blue heron, droopy black crest, long yellow beak
CHR_026.movement: Slow, wobbly dozing; sudden snap of the neck when startled.
